sec: Important symptoms, childhood Cushing's and first diagnostic cut-offs · p846

items.q: The proximal myopathy of Cushing's is characteristically:
opts: Bilateral, proximal, symmetric, lower limbs > upper limbs
items.exp: Proximal myopathy is B/L, proximal, symmetric, LL > UL. (Book p846)

items.q: Facial plethora in Cushing's results from:
opts: Thinning of skin and loss of subcutaneous fat
items.exp: Facial plethora follows thinning of skin and loss of subcutaneous fat. (Book p846)

items.q: The violaceous striae of Cushing's are due to:
items.exp: Violaceous striae occur d/t loss of collagen. (Book p846)

items.q: A child with obesity, short stature and delayed bone age presents with fractures. The book links young-onset osteoporosis and fractures to:
items.exp: Young-onset osteoporosis → fractures, with short stature, obesity and delayed bone age, are important protein-catabolism features. (Book p846)

items.q: Which combination plus central obesity should trigger screening per the Endocrine Society of India?
opts: Protein catabolism features, DM/HTN metabolic syndrome, incidental adrenal mass
items.exp: Protein catabolism signs, diabetes/HTN metabolic syndrome and incidental adrenal mass + central obesity → screening. (Book p846)

items.q: Match adult vs childhood Cushing's — 1) Adult sex  2) Childhood sex  3) Childhood cause order … A) m >> F  B) Adrenal > pituitary  C) F > M
items.exp: Adult F > M; childhood m >> F with adrenal > pituitary causes. (Book p846)

items.q: Childhood Cushing's shows LESS of which feature?
items.exp: Childhood Cushing's: less protein catabolism, obesity, ↑ adrenal androgen → precocious puberty. (Book p846)

items.q: The treatment named for childhood Cushing's with a good response is:
items.exp: Treatment of childhood Cushing's: radiotherapy (good response). (Book p846)

items.q: Cushing's syndrome is ruled out when midnight serum cortisol and midnight salivary cortisol are respectively:
items.exp: If midnight serum cortisol ≤1.8 µg/dL and midnight salivary cortisol ≤5.5 mmol/L → Cushing's ruled out; otherwise do 8 AM plasma cortisol. (Book p846)
